notes.title: Update: Version 1.3.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you're having a great holiday season!
A day early, we made an update before starting this new year, we hope you will like it.


The crossbreeding of hens has been added, genetic manipulations available in the lab, allow you to create two different colors of hens from eggs. With these two extra colors you will be able to cross them to obtain different colors that also have their own diets, which they will find in the wild flora and fauna. It's up to you to select your hens to obtain the crosses you want in your ecosystem!


Happy New Year to you, have a good day/night

Thank you for your support :)

notes.title: Update: Version 1.3.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is the sickness system as promised!

[list]
[*]Added diseases, for the moment 3 diseases are present (Injury, fever and high toxicity), each bringing its own malus. You will be able to heal yourself with the fabrication of remedies in the lab. These diseases do not appear randomly, which means that once you have found out how it is contracted you can prevent the disease by being careful with your actions, better prevent than cure!

The effects of the diseases work with a passive system, this same system will be used in future updates to give temporary bonuses to the dishes you cook!

[*]As a result, new recipes have been added to the lab, Bandage and Flu Remedy.

Fishing has become a bit harder, if you miss your fish or throw your bait too close to it, it will run away and will not come back, it will give more spice to your fishing trips :)
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy this update and add spice to your games.

I wish you a good and pleasant weekend, good game to you!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is what's new with this update:

Addition of a button (bottom right) that displays real-time statistics of animal populations and number of trees by species.
These data will be useful for the player to balance the ecosystem. If you observe (zoom out is easier) you will be able to learn a lot about the behavior of animals and the influence of trees on animals. You will then be able to balance by limiting or increasing this or that species of trees and planting them strategically on the world. Leon will have less work (and so will Izzie!) regulating animal populations. Don't forget that even harmful, an animal is also useful ;).

On the old saves with a lot of trees, it is possible to have to wait about ten days (in the game ^^) for the ecosystem to balance. You can speed up the process by making Izzie take a walk in the forest :) 

I hope you like this update

Have a good game and a good weekend! :)

notes.title: Update: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are the modifications and the new features of this update:

[list]
[*]Some foods rot over time, it's up to you to manage your food stock. When food rots, its stats decrease and become unusable in the kitchen. For the already existing saves the calculation of perishable food will only start when the item is displayed (either in the containers or in the inventory), not all of them will be rotten don't worry. Eat what you had in stock first to avoid too many losses ;). The ready meals that you have in stock and that would be rotten before you can eat them are still consumable but...they will give half of their basic values and in the next updates will strongly increase the chances for Leon to get sick (you know that you will have to manage Leon's health).

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1476570921176470107/661F767742561C73FAA5622139229659640987D9/[/img]

[*]Be able to preserve food in canned food in the enhanced kitchen.
[*]Addition of sand and salt (which can be obtained by digging the ground with the pickaxe) which are mainly used in the craft of preserves.
[*]Recipes are now separated into sub-categories to simplify navigation (future updates will further simplify it)

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's what's new with this update:

[list]
[*]A great depth of play has been brought to the resources. The "wild" plants that grow around trees are no longer immortal. The fungi live 24 hours and the other plants live 48 hours. On the other hand, it is now possible for the plant to reproduce if it has the possibility, if it has place around it. What makes the sickle, your agility and the observation of biodiversity important. You can cut the plants that are preventing the plant(s) you want to thrive. Obviously if the plant reproduces, its longevity also increases, which will allow you to make a small field of selected wild plants and immortal (unless we cut them or if we cut the mother tree). In a future update, breeding may be possible with more or less autonomy, livestock will be able to feed on wild plants, we will be able to have wooded pastures with plants specially selected for feeding animals that will be raised there!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937118246319/FE3B8AA629D658130FBCBBFF2D1BE7799FBF1C9D/[/img]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937118247358/EB8D58371BCE99D1A20D9EE36F5EC473839887A7/[/img]

[*]Recipes used for tool repairs or recharging (for the Firefly Headlamp) are now marked.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937117734613/BEA7A25F8AEB38791DC76FF38288EA779302A198/[/img]

[*]Quick access of the item equipped to the hand when using a container or workbench, reducing the number of actions to do for simple things.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937117724234/389030D4B81AFE14E57555817B00166ECD918C32/[/img]

[*]Addition of important tutorial texts (which will stop the player and ask to validate the text) which facilitates the understanding of the game for new players (without spoiling the surprise of the discovery)
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937117768727/799B3C59B35F6B4D01E148A7E986FF9B3C0A88A4/[/img]

[*]Some improvements on drag and drop of objects.

[*]The current and maximum amount of an object is now displayed in the info panel
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1473191937117725729/1B1C9C252146DFD4BD1BDFF72175D0677370D0A0/[/img]

[*]Bugs fixed

[*]Balancing some stats

[*]The hens have changed their appearance :)
[/list]

Some new features were not written on the roadmap, but I found it necessary to take the time to make this update which brings more depth and improves the quality of life.

Hope you enjoy this update, good game to you and have a nice weekend! :)

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone, who says week-end says new update! :)
I'm sorry if this update is less important than the others. I had to work on the Android update.

Here are the changes and new features:

[list]
[*]Irrigation system, you can now dig a hole in the ground with the pickaxe that will serve as irrigation, you can fill it with the watering can or wait for the rain. It works like an automatic water sprinkler, when it is full it will water all its neighboring tiles up to 3 times (which makes 24 waterings that you don't need to do). Filling it requires less water than watering the tiles by hand in addition to saving time.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1295297877737719439/BBBB8F444AE4473A04468E8F96E4F9784186C42B/[/img]
[*]You can now remove the composted and plowed/planted tiles with the pickaxe. Be careful, destroying a tile where a plant is grown will destroy the plant.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1295297877737721920/3B06819AB004163CEA764A2541CCF0493FB723F8/[/img]
[*]Addition of a container, the medicine cabinet
[*]Expansion of storage space for any container made with iron
[*]The Watering Can can now hold up to 1000 units of water (instead of 900)
[*]The gestation of the animals is paused/freezed when they are hungry. And they no longer breed if one or both partners are hungry. (More sense and it avoids the almost infinite multiplication of animals, especially rats)
[*]Some item's sprites have been polished.
[*]The game version is now shown in the main menu
[*]Fixed several bugs including the bug where animals did not leave a fabric bag.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this update, if you are curious about future things that will be implemented, you can see them here: https://trello.com/b/NJTmhYkk/green-project-roadmap

Good weekend and good game to you! :)
